tabs.label: WFP Workforce Cost
tabs.content:
SKIPCHECK;

#Region Rules Video Short

#1 *Comment block Crtl+/, Search ctrl+F
#2 *Regions Collapse, Select
#3 *Autocomplete, Functions Autocomplete, Auto Check
#4 *Trace to check rule, Lineage
#5 *History
#6 *UI, Font Size, Mini Map, Theme, split screens, Format Code, Ref

#7 History and Diff  

#EndRegion

# Non-calculating versions (Actual + snapshots) hold stored data — skip all calc.
[] = N:IF(ELPAR('WFP Version', !WFP Version, 1) @= 'Non-Calculating',STET,CONTINUE);

#REGION ===== Variance versions (P6) — the "Variance" parent is calculating =====
# Act vs Bud: hard actuals variance, closed periods only (WFP Period "Actuals
# Closed" attr, set by WFP Load Actuals). Positive = overspend.
['Act vs Bud'] = N:
  IF( ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Actuals Closed') = 1,
      DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, 'Actual', !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, !WFP Pay Component, !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Cost Measure)
    - DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, 'Budget', !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, !WFP Pay Component, !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Cost Measure), 0 );

# Fcst vs Bud: rolling outlook vs plan; all periods (Forecast carries Actual in
# closed months, so at FY this is the expected full-year over/under-run).
['Fcst vs Bud'] = N:
      DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, 'Forecast', !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, !WFP Pay Component, !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Cost Measure)
    - DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, 'Budget', !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, !WFP Pay Component, !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Cost Measure);
#ENDREGION

#REGION FX vs operational split of Act vs Bud — Reporting currency only.
# Var FX + Var Operational = Act vs Bud (in Reporting), because Budget Reporting
# and Reporting @ Budget FX are equal by definition.
['Var FX'] = N:
  IF( !WFP Currency @= 'Reporting' & ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Actuals Closed') = 1,
      DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, 'Actual', !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, !WFP Pay Component, 'Reporting', !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Cost Measure)
    - DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, 'Actual', !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, !WFP Pay Component, 'Reporting @ Budget FX', !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Cost Measure), 0 );

['Var Operational'] = N:
  IF( !WFP Currency @= 'Reporting' & ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Actuals Closed') = 1,
      DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, 'Actual', !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, !WFP Pay Component, 'Reporting @ Budget FX', !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Cost Measure)
    - DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, 'Budget', !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, !WFP Pay Component, 'Reporting @ Budget FX', !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Cost Measure), 0 );
#ENDREGION

#REGION Act vs Prior Fcst (P6c): forecast accuracy — Actual vs the prior-month forecast
# snapshot named on the WFP Period "Prior Fcst Snapshot" attr. Only fires for
# months that have a prior snapshot. Positive = actuals over the prior forecast.
['Act vs Prior Fcst'] = N:
  IF( ATTRS('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Prior Fcst Snapshot') @<> '',
      DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, 'Actual', !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, !WFP Pay Component, !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Cost Measure)
    - DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, ATTRS('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Prior Fcst Snapshot'), !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, !WFP Pay Component, !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Cost Measure), 0 );
#ENDREGION

#REGION ===== Capitalised labour (P5) — must precede the component + currency rules =====
# Amount Capex / Amount Opex are a split of Amount by cost-centre Capex %.
# Fire ONLY at all-leaf intersections; consolidations (incl. Reporting currency,
# handled by the translation rule below) roll up naturally.
['Amount Capex'] = N:
      IF( ELISANC('WFP Pay Component', 'Cost to Company', !WFP Pay Component) = 1,
          ['Amount'] * ATTRN('WFP Cost Centre', !WFP Cost Centre, 'Capex %'), 0 );

['Amount Opex'] = N:['Amount'] - ['Amount Capex'];
#ENDREGION

#REGION ===== Reporting-currency translation (measure-aware) =====
# WFP Workforce Cost dims: Period, Version, Entity, Cost Centre, Pay Component, Currency, Position, Measure
['Reporting'] = N:
    DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, !WFP Pay Component, 'GBP', !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Cost Measure) * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'GBP', 'Average', 'Rate')
  + DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, !WFP Pay Component, 'USD', !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Cost Measure) * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'USD', 'Average', 'Rate')
  + DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, !WFP Pay Component, 'NZD', !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Cost Measure) * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'NZD', 'Average', 'Rate');
#ENDREGION

#REGION ===== Constant currency (P5) =====
['Reporting @ Budget FX'] = N:
    DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, !WFP Pay Component, 'GBP', !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Cost Measure) * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, 'Budget', 'GBP', 'Average', 'Rate')
  + DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, !WFP Pay Component, 'USD', !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Cost Measure) * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, 'Budget', 'USD', 'Average', 'Rate')
  + DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, !WFP Pay Component, 'NZD', !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Cost Measure) * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, 'Budget', 'NZD', 'Average', 'Rate');
#ENDREGION

#REGION ===== Helpers =====
['_Start Index'] = N:
  IF( DB('WFP Hiring Plan', !WFP Version, !WFP Position, 'Hire Month') > 0,
      DB('WFP Hiring Plan', !WFP Version, !WFP Position, 'Hire Month'),
      IF( ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Position Status') @= 'TBH', 9999,
          ATTRN('WFP Period', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Start Period'), 'Period Index') ) );

['_End Index'] = N:
  IF( DB('WFP Hiring Plan', !WFP Version, !WFP Position, 'Attrition Month') > 0,
      DB('WFP Hiring Plan', !WFP Version, !WFP Position, 'Attrition Month') - 1,
      IF( ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'End Period') @= '', 999,
          ATTRN('WFP Period', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'End Period'), 'Period Index') ) );

['_In Window'] = N: IF(ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Period Index') >= ['_Start Index'] & ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Period Index') <= ['_End Index'], 1, 0);

['_Start Frac'] = N:
  IF(ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Period Index') = ['_Start Index'],
     IF( DB('WFP Hiring Plan', !WFP Version, !WFP Position, 'Hire Month') > 0, 1,
         (ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Days In Month') - ATTRN('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Start Day') + 1) / ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Days In Month') ), 1);

['_End Frac'] = N:
  IF( DB('WFP Hiring Plan', !WFP Version, !WFP Position, 'Attrition Month') > 0
      & ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Period Index') = ['_End Index'], 1,
      IF(ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'End Period') @<> '' & ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Period Index') = ['_End Index'],
        ATTRN('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'End Day') / ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Days In Month'), 1) );

['_Active Fraction'] = N: ['_In Window'] * ['_Start Frac'] * ['_End Frac'];

['_Annual Salary'] = N:
  IF(ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Position Status') @= 'Filled' & DB('WFP Workforce Input', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Position, 'Base Salary') > 0,
     DB('WFP Workforce Input', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Position, 'Base Salary'),
     DB('WFP Pay Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Grade'), ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Job Family'), ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Location'), 'Salary Mid'));

['_Monthly Base Full'] = N:
  IF(!WFP Currency @= ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Salary Currency') & !WFP Entity @= ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity') & !WFP Cost Centre @= ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
     ['_Annual Salary'] / 12 * DB('WFP Workforce Input', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Position, 'FTE'), 0);

['_Earnings YTD'] = N:
  ['Base']
  + IF(SUBST(!WFP Period, 6, 2) @= '01', 0, DB('WFP Workforce Cost', ATTRS('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Prior Period'), !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, '_Earnings YTD', !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, 'Amount'));

['_Employer Tax YTD'] = N:
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 1', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 1', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 1', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 2', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 2', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 2', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 3', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 3', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 3', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 4', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 4', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 4', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 5', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 5', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 5', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 6', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 6', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 6', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 7', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 7', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 7', 'Rate');

['_Prior Employer Tax YTD'] = N: IF(SUBST(!WFP Period, 6, 2) @= '01', 0, DB('WFP Workforce Cost', ATTRS('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Prior Period'), !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, '_Employer Tax YTD', !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, 'Amount'));

['_Employee Tax YTD'] = N:
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 1', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 1', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 1', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 2', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 2', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 2', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 3', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 3', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 3', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 4', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 4', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 4', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 5', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 5', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 5', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 6', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 6', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 6', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 7', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 7', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 7', 'Rate');

['_Prior Employee Tax YTD'] = N: IF(SUBST(!WFP Period, 6, 2) @= '01', 0, DB('WFP Workforce Cost', ATTRS('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Prior Period'), !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, '_Employee Tax YTD', !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, 'Amount'));
#ENDREGION

#REGION ===== Components (local currency) =====
['Base'] = N: ['_Monthly Base Full'] * ['_Active Fraction'];

['Gross Pay'] = N: ['Base'];

['Employer Payroll Tax'] = N: IF(ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Employment Type') @= 'Contractor', 0, ['_Employer Tax YTD'] - ['_Prior Employer Tax YTD']);

['Employer Pension'] = N: IF(ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Employment Type') @= 'Contractor', 0, ['Base'] * DB('WFP Pay Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Grade'), ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Job Family'), ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Location'), 'Pension Pct'));

['Employee Income Tax'] = N: IF(ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Employment Type') @= 'Contractor', 0, ['_Employee Tax YTD'] - ['_Prior Employee Tax YTD']);

['Employee Pension'] = N: IF(ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Employment Type') @= 'Contractor', 0, ['Base'] * DB('WFP Pay Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Grade'), ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Job Family'), ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Location'), 'Employee Pension Pct'));

['Benefits'] = N:
  IF(['_Monthly Base Full'] = 0, 0,
  IF(ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Employment Type') @= 'Contractor', 0,
     DB('WFP Pay Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Grade'), ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Job Family'), ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Location'), 'Benefits Annual') / 12 * DB('WFP Workforce Input', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Position, 'FTE') * ['_Active Fraction']));

['Bonus'] = N:
  IF(ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Employment Type') @= 'Contractor', 0,
     ['Base'] * DB('WFP Assumptions', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, 'Bonus Pool %'));

['One-Time'] = N:
  IF(!WFP Currency @= ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Salary Currency')
     & !WFP Entity @= ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity')
     & !WFP Cost Centre @= ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
     DB('WFP Workforce Input', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Position, 'One-Time Amount'), 0);

['Net Pay'] = N: ['Gross Pay'] - ['Employee Deductions'];
#ENDREGION

FEEDERS;

#REGION ===== Local trunk — each arrow is a true dependency =====
# Base is the root: monthly full × active fraction. Everything cost-related hangs off it.
['_Monthly Base Full'] => ['Base'];

# Components that are direct functions of Base.
['Base'] => ['Gross Pay'], ['Employer Pension'], ['Employee Pension'], ['Bonus'];
# benefits = monthly full × rate × FTE × active frac
['_Monthly Base Full'] => ['Benefits'];   

# YTD tax chain — fed from its own driver, not from base.
['Base'] => ['_Earnings YTD'];
['_Earnings YTD'] => ['_Employer Tax YTD'], ['_Employee Tax YTD'];
['_Employer Tax YTD'] => ['Employer Payroll Tax'];
['_Employee Tax YTD'] => ['Employee Income Tax'];

# Net pay = gross − employee deductions. Feed from Gross Pay (a leaf rule cell);
# wherever Gross Pay computes, Net Pay computes too.
['Gross Pay'] => ['Net Pay'];
#ENDREGION

#REGION ===== Local-currency capex/opex split (salary currency) =====
# Capex/Opex apply to Cost to Company components (CtC = base, ER tax, ER pension,
# benefits); Bonus and One-Time are Opex-only (they sit in Total Compensation but
# are not employer on-costs).
['Base'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Base', !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, 'Amount Capex'),
            DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Base', !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, 'Amount Opex');
['Employer Payroll Tax'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Payroll Tax', !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, 'Amount Capex'),
                            DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Payroll Tax', !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, 'Amount Opex');
['Employer Pension'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Pension', !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, 'Amount Capex'),
                        DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Pension', !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, 'Amount Opex');
['Benefits'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Benefits', !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, 'Amount Capex'),
                DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Benefits', !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, 'Amount Opex');
['Bonus'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Bonus', !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, 'Amount Opex');
['One-Time'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'One-Time', !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, 'Amount Opex');
#ENDREGION

#REGION ===== Reporting + Budget-FX currency translation =====
# Each component's Reporting / Budget-FX leaf is computed by the translation rules
# from the LOCAL amount — so feed it from the local component's own driver.
['Base'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Base', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount'),
            DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Base', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount Capex'),
            DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Base', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount Opex'),
            DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Base', 'Reporting @ Budget FX', !WFP Position, 'Amount'),
            DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Base', 'Reporting @ Budget FX', !WFP Position, 'Amount Capex'),
            DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Base', 'Reporting @ Budget FX', !WFP Position, 'Amount Opex');
['Gross Pay'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Gross Pay', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount'),
                 DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Gross Pay', 'Reporting @ Budget FX', !WFP Position, 'Amount');
['Employer Payroll Tax'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount'),
                            DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount Capex'),
                            DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount Opex'),
                            DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Reporting @ Budget FX', !WFP Position, 'Amount'),
                            DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Reporting @ Budget FX', !WFP Position, 'Amount Capex'),
                            DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Reporting @ Budget FX', !WFP Position, 'Amount Opex');
['Employer Pension'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Pension', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount'),
                        DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Pension', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount Capex'),
                        DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Pension', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount Opex'),
                        DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Pension', 'Reporting @ Budget FX', !WFP Position, 'Amount'),
                        DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Pension', 'Reporting @ Budget FX', !WFP Position, 'Amount Capex'),
                        DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Pension', 'Reporting @ Budget FX', !WFP Position, 'Amount Opex');
['Benefits'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Benefits', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount'),
                DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Benefits', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount Capex'),
